products.short_description: Effective ice and snow melting solutions for roads, sidewalks, and driveways. Trusted by municipalities and contractors for reliable winter safety.
products.original_description:
# De-icing Salt Solutions

Effective ice and snow melting solutions for roads, sidewalks, and driveways. Trusted by municipalities and contractors for reliable winter safety.

## Two Types of De-icing Salt

Choose between rock salt from ancient deposits or sea salt from natural evaporation

## Why Choose Our De-icing Salt

Superior quality and performance for effective winter road maintenance

### Fast Ice Melting

Lowers freezing point effectively, ensuring quick snow and ice removal for safer road conditions.

### Cost-Effective

Competitive pricing with efficient performance, requiring less product for maximum results.

### Reliable Supply

Consistent availability and timely delivery with expert technical support and guidance.

## Our De-icing Salt Products

Choose from our range of high-quality de-icing solutions

### De-icing Rock Salt

Naturally occurring sodium chloride mined from ancient sea deposits. Mined from Siwa oasis, this traditional choice provides reliable ice melting with large crystals that offer excellent traction on slippery surfaces.

- High Purity: Exceeding 99% NaCl for maximum efficiency

- Ancient Deposits: From remnants of evaporated seas millions of years ago

- Low Moisture: Less than 1% to prevent clumping

- Coarse Texture: Provides traction while melting ice

- Cost-Effective: Preferred choice for roads and pavements

- Various Grain Sizes: Available to suit different applications

**Available Packaging:**

25 kg, 50 kg bags, big bags, or in bulk

### De-icing Sea Salt

Produced by evaporating seawater, this economically priced solution delivers rapid ice melting. Easy to spread and highly effective, it's the traditional choice proven reliable across diverse environments.

- Rapid Melting: Highly effective at lowering freezing point

- Easy Application: Spreads smoothly on various surfaces

- Cost-Effective: Economically priced for all budgets

- Versatile Use: Suitable for urban, suburban, and rural areas

- Proven Reliability: Traditional choice for highways and driveways

- Comprehensive Coverage: Perfect for roads, sidewalks, and parking lots

**Available Packaging:**

25 kg, 50 kg bags, big bags, or in bulk

products.name: Water Softening & Tablet Salt
products.short_description: Premium salt solutions for water softening systems. Choose between tablets or granular salt to transform hard water into soft water, protecting your appliances and enhancing water quality.
products.original_description:
# Water Softener Salt Products

Premium salt solutions for water softening systems. Choose between tablets or granular salt to transform hard water into soft water, protecting your appliances and enhancing water quality.

## Our Water Softener Salt Products

Choose the perfect salt solution for your water softening system

### Tablets Salt

Compressed salt tablets designed for optimal dissolution and efficiency in water softening systems. Perfect for residential and commercial applications.

- Slow, controlled dissolution

- Reduces bridging and mushing

- Easy to handle and store

- Ideal for all softener types

### Water Softening Salt

Premium granular salt crystals that dissolve quickly and efficiently. Excellent choice for high-capacity water softening systems.

- Fast-dissolving crystals

- High purity formula

- Prevents salt bridging

- Cost-effective solution

## Hard Water Problems & Our Solution

Understanding the challenges of hard water and how our salt provides the perfect solution

### Hard Water Problems

Hard water causes soap to lather poorly, leaves spots on dishes, makes clothes feel rough, and shortens appliance lifespan. Scale buildup damages pipes and reduces efficiency of water heaters and appliances.

### Our Solution

Our premium water softener salt effectively removes calcium and magnesium ions, transforming hard water into soft water. This protects your appliances, improves cleaning results, and enhances your overall water quality experience.

## Benefits of Water Softener Salt

Comprehensive advantages for your home and appliances

### Prevents Scale Build-up

Protects pipes, fixtures, and water heaters from harmful mineral deposits and scale accumulation.

### Extends Appliance Life

Helps dishwashers and washing machines last longer by preventing mineral buildup and corrosion.

### Improves Cleaning Efficiency

Reduces soap film and buildup in sinks, bathtubs, and washing machines for better cleaning results.

## Product Quality Specifications

Premium quality standards for optimal water softening performance

### Purity

**99.55%+**

Sodium chloride content

### Humidity

**< 0.15%**

Low moisture content

### pH Level

**≤ 70 ppm**

Optimal pH balance

products.original_description:
# Agriculture Salt

Like humans, animals cannot do without sodium in their diet. Our agriculture salt is a frequently used additive to concentrated feed for optimal animal nutrition.

## Why Animals Need Salt

Understanding the critical role of sodium in animal nutrition

The use of salt in animals provides significant contribution to growth, development, and milk yield by regulating water and dry matter consumption. Agriculture salt is a frequently used additive to concentrated feed, ensuring optimal health and productivity.

## Key Benefits for Animal Health

Essential advantages of proper salt supplementation in animal feed

### Growth & Development

Provides significant contribution to animal growth and development through proper sodium regulation.

### Water Regulation

Regulates water consumption, ensuring proper hydration and metabolic function in livestock.

### Dry Matter Intake

Controls dry matter consumption, optimizing feed efficiency and nutritional uptake.

### Milk Yield

Enhances milk production in dairy animals through improved metabolic processes.

## Available Product Forms

Practical and effective solutions for different feeding methods

### Licking Blocks

Licking blocks are a practical and effective solution for feeding raw materials to livestock. Easy to use and provides controlled salt intake.

- Easy to use and install

- Long-lasting and weather-resistant

- Controlled salt intake

- Suitable for pasture feeding

### Granular Form

Agriculture salt in granular form, designed for mixing with concentrated animal feed for precise and uniform distribution.

- Easy mixing with feed

- Precise dosage control

- Uniform distribution

- Compatible with feed systems

## Suitable for All Livestock

Essential nutrition for various farm animals

- **Cattle** — Dairy and beef cattle

- **Sheep** — Wool and meat production

- **Goats** — Milk and meat goats

- **Horses** — Working and sport horses

- **Pigs** — Commercial pig farming

- **Poultry** — Chickens and other birds

## Available Packaging Options

We provide packaging in different sizes: 25kg bags, 50kg bags, big bags, and loose in bulk

products.original_description:
# Drilling Salt

Specialized salt for exploration and drilling operations in the oil and gas industry, especially for deep wells. Essential for wellbore stabilization, tool cooling, and pressure control.

## Key Functions in Drilling Operations

Essential roles of drilling salt in oil and gas exploration

### Wellbore Stabilization

Strengthens limestone formations and provides crucial support to well walls, preventing dangerous collapse during drilling operations.

*Critical Benefits: Maintains structural integrity of deep wells and prevents formation damage*

### Tool Cooling

Acts as an effective cooling agent for drilling equipment, protecting valuable tools and machinery from excessive heat damage.

*Protection Features: Extends equipment life and maintains optimal drilling performance*

### Pressure Control

Added to drilling fluids to regulate wellbore pressure and maintain overall well stability throughout the drilling process.

*Stability Control: Ensures safe drilling conditions and prevents blowouts*

## Drilling Applications

Specialized uses in oil and gas exploration

- **Deep Well Drilling** — Essential for deep exploration wells

- **Oil Exploration** — Critical in oil discovery operations

- **Gas Drilling** — Specialized for gas well operations

- **Equipment Protection** — Safeguards drilling machinery

- **Formation Support** — Stabilizes geological formations

- **Pressure Management** — Controls wellbore pressure

## Quality & Manufacturing

Specialized production for drilling industry requirements

### Specialized Manufacturing

Our drilling salt is specially manufactured to meet the stringent requirements of drilling operations, ensuring optimal performance in challenging conditions.

### Contamination Prevention

Manufactured with strict quality controls to prevent contamination, ensuring the integrity of drilling fluids and overall drilling operations.

## Available Packaging Options

Flexible packaging solutions for drilling operations

### Minimal Impurities

features_and_benefits.title: Exceptional Purity

features_and_benefits.title: Minimal Impurities
features_and_benefits.description: Industry-leading low impurity content with the lowest percentage of insoluble matter and contaminants, ensuring optimal performance in your processes.

features_and_benefits.title: Dual Sourcing Advantage

products.short_description: Premium quality salt essential for over 50% of chemical manufacturing processes. Trusted by industry leaders worldwide for consistent purity and reliability.
products.original_description:
# Chemical & Industrial Salt

Premium quality salt essential for over 50% of chemical manufacturing processes. Trusted by industry leaders worldwide for consistent purity and reliability.

## Why Choose Our Industrial Salt

Engineered for excellence in chemical manufacturing and industrial applications

### Chemical Synthesis

Essential for the production of chlorine and caustic soda through electrolysis, supporting over 50% of chemical manufacturing processes.

### Industrial Applications

Used in glass, paper, plastic, rubber, textiles, dyes, leather, cosmetics, and pharmaceutical manufacturing.

### Quality Assurance

ISO certified production facilities ensuring consistent purity levels and meeting international quality standards.

## Product Gallery

High-quality industrial salt in various forms and packaging

## Industrial Applications

Versatile applications across multiple industries

- **Glass Manufacturing** — Essential flux agent

- **Paper Production** — Bleaching processes

- **Plastic Industry** — PVC production

- **Textile Processing** — Dyeing and finishing

- **Pharmaceuticals** — Active ingredients

- **Cosmetics** — Formulation base

en.name: Chemical & Industrial Salt
en.card_summary: High-purity salt for chlor-alkali production and manufacturing industries.
en.short_description: High-purity salt for chlor-alkali production and a wide range of manufacturing industries.
overview: Salt is one of the chemical industry's most important raw materials. It is the basis of chlorine and caustic soda production by electrolysis, which in turn supply a large share of all chemical products.
We supply industrial salt with consistent purity for glass, paper, plastics, rubber, textiles, dyes, leather, cosmetics and pharmaceutical manufacturing.

benefits.title: Wide industrial use

benefits.title: Consistent purity

fr.name: Sel chimique et industriel
fr.card_summary: Sel de haute pureté pour l'électrolyse chlore-soude et l'industrie manufacturière.
fr.short_description: Un sel de haute pureté pour la production de chlore et de soude et pour de nombreuses industries manufacturières.
overview: Le sel compte parmi les matières premières essentielles de la chimie. Il est à la base de la production de chlore et de soude caustique par électrolyse, deux produits qui entrent à leur tour dans une grande partie de l'industrie chimique.
Nous fournissons un sel industriel de pureté constante pour la verrerie, la papeterie, la plasturgie, le caoutchouc, le textile, les colorants, le cuir, la cosmétique et l'industrie pharmaceutique.

benefits.title: Synthèse chimique
benefits.description: Matière première indispensable à la production de chlore et de soude caustique par électrolyse.

benefits.title: Nombreux usages industriels
benefits.description: Utilisé en verrerie, papeterie, plasturgie, textile, cuir, cosmétique et pharmacie.

benefits.title: Pureté constante
benefits.description: Une qualité stable d'une expédition à l'autre, pour des procédés maîtrisés.

products.name: Textile & Dyeing Salt
products.short_description: Salt is used in the dyeing process and textile cleaning, as it improves the color, quality, and stability of the dye on the fabric. Additionally, it contributes to improving environmental health by reducing the use of harmful chemicals in the dyeing process.
products.original_description:
# Textile Salt

Salt is used in the dyeing process and textile cleaning, as it improves the color, quality, and stability of the dye on the fabric. Additionally, it contributes to improving environmental health by reducing the use of harmful chemicals in the dyeing process.

## Key Features & Benefits

High-purity textile salt designed for optimal dyeing and cleaning performance

### Enhanced Dye Quality

Improves the color, quality, and stability of dyes on fabric during the textile dyeing process.

### Textile Cleaning

Effective in textile cleaning processes, ensuring thorough and efficient fabric treatment.

### Eco-Friendly

Contributes to reducing harmful chemicals in dyeing processes, supporting sustainable textile manufacturing.

## Technical Specifications

High-purity textile salt with precise chemical composition

### Purity

**99%+**

Sodium chloride content

### Humidity

**≤1%**

Minimal moisture content

### pH Level

**≤70 ppm**

Optimal pH balance

## Available Packaging Options

Flexible packaging solutions to meet your industrial and commercial needs

en.name: Textile & Dyeing Salt
en.card_summary: High-purity salt for textile dyeing and cleaning processes.
en.short_description: High-purity salt for textile dyeing and cleaning — for better colour quality and dye stability on fabric.
overview: In textile dyeing, salt helps dyes bind to fibres, improving colour quality and stability on the fabric. It is also used in textile cleaning processes.
Using salt in the dyeing process can also reduce reliance on harsher chemicals, supporting cleaner textile production.

benefits.title: Better dye results
benefits.description: Improves colour, quality and stability of dyes on fabric.

benefits.title: Textile cleaning
benefits.description: Effective in fabric cleaning and treatment processes.

benefits.title: Cleaner processing
benefits.description: Helps reduce harmful chemicals in dyeing processes.

fr.name: Sel pour textile et teinture
fr.card_summary: Sel de haute pureté pour la teinture et le nettoyage des textiles.
fr.short_description: Un sel de haute pureté pour la teinture et le nettoyage des textiles, pour des couleurs plus belles et mieux fixées.
overview: En teinture, le sel favorise la fixation des colorants sur les fibres et améliore la qualité et la tenue des couleurs. Il intervient aussi dans le nettoyage des textiles.
Son emploi en teinture permet en outre de limiter le recours à des produits chimiques plus agressifs, au profit d'une production plus propre.

benefits.title: De meilleurs résultats en teinture
benefits.description: Améliore la couleur, la qualité et la tenue des teintures sur le tissu.

benefits.title: Nettoyage des textiles
benefits.description: Efficace dans le nettoyage et le traitement des tissus.

benefits.title: Un procédé plus propre
benefits.description: Contribue à réduire les produits chimiques nocifs en teinture.

ar.short_description: ملح عالي النقاوة لصباغة وتنظيف المنسوجات، لجودة ألوان أفضل وثبات أعلى للصبغة على القماش.

ويساعد استخدام الملح في عملية الصباغة أيضاً على تقليل الاعتماد على المواد الكيميائية الأكثر ضرراً، دعماً لإنتاج نسيج أنظف.
